product_one_liner.value: interface.ai provides AI agents that automate customer service and complete banking transactions for credit unions and community banks.

pricing_page.notes: The site directs buyers to a demo rather than public pricing; the cited review also reports that the pricing URL returns a 404.

named_customers.notes: Both are named in the homepage's customer-results section.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn reports 193 employees and PitchBook lists 175; both fall within this band.

founded_year.notes: The company states it was founded in 2015; its careers timeline identifies 2019 as the rebrand and U.S. launch.

eng_blog.notes: The index contains product announcements, customer stories, and banking-AI thought leadership, rather than qualifying engineering-authored build posts.

public_docs.notes: No public product-docs, developer-portal, or help-center link was found in the site navigation/footer; the knowledge center contains marketing guides, ebooks, and tools.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Live posting for Applied AI Engineer, Business Automation, in San Francisco.

model_provider.notes: Product, security, blog, and subprocessor pages describe a multi-LLM architecture but do not identify a specific underlying model or provider.

compliance_certs.notes: The Trust Center lists SOC 2 Type 2, ISO/IEC 27001:2022, and GDPR compliance.

last_funding.notes: Announced October 22, 2024, led by Avataar Venture Partners. Series A follows the company's own terminology.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified financing was announced October 22, 2024, before the requested 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Live Account Executive posting for a full-time, on-site San Francisco role.

launched_6mo.notes: September 17 and October 1, 2026 customer sessions introduce the V6 Assemble console and customer sandbox; the V6 release page says the rebuilt core already powers Voice AI.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: A June 18, 2026 announcement introduces two new executive hires: Michael Azevedo, VP of Sales, and Bryan Dooley, SVP of Customer Experience. Individual start dates are not stated.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Salesforce is listed as a product integration; this establishes an integration signal, not necessarily internal CRM adoption.
